methodology.checks: GitHub GET /commits/{frozen_head_sha}/check-runs?filter=latest, paginated at 100; current reported runs, not all historical attempts.
methodology.statuses: GitHub GET /commits/{frozen_head_sha}/status, paginated at 100; combined latest context statuses, not all historical events.
methodology.reviews: GitHub GET /pulls/{number}/reviews, paginated at 100. Review commit_id is retained; COMMENTED bot submissions are not approval.
methodology.scope: Evidence is commit-specific. No workflows were dispatched or rerun, and no product tests were executed by this audit. Successful checks are GitHub-reported results, not a new local test run.
methodology.qualification: No row establishes merge/release qualification. Required-check applicability, independent review outside GitHub, release gates and combined-stack testing were not inferred. Skipped, neutral, queued, missing, and failing checks remain distinct.
methodology.pagination: 360 original and 9 additional check/status/review endpoints; every endpoint fit one 100-item page and its advertised count was reconciled.
methodology.context_selection: GitHub filter=latest can retain older workflow suites. All duplicate app/name groups were inspected (#328, #317, #272); 21 workflow records identify workflow path, event, branch, run time and attempt. Checks from a different branch on the same commit were excluded from current-PR counts. Within the same app/workflow-path/event/branch context only the newest observed workflow run is selected; superseded checks remain in the raw checks array with exclusion reason. This removes three superseded cancelled CLI jobs from #272 and the older passing run from #328; it does not change the aggregate PR classifications.
methodology.counts: The checks arrays retain all 4,064 raw observations. Per-PR counts and CI states use 3,994 selected checks; 70 older or alternate-branch observations remain excluded with explicit reasons. Original 120 PR records and their timestamps are unchanged.
methodology.refresh: Source inventory expanded from 420/120 to 423/123 after a final drift check. Only #353–#355 CI/reviews were fetched again; old observations were not relabelled fresh.

table_schema.head_sha: Every check inherits the enclosing PR head.sha; equality was verified before encoding.
table_schema.details_url: If workflow_run_id is non-null, https://github.com/{repository}/actions/runs/{workflow_run_id}/job/{id}; otherwise other_details_url.
table_schema.selected: All check IDs are current-context selected except IDs in excluded_checks. Excluded rows remain present.
table_schema.endpoint_url: https://api.github.com/repos/{repository}/ + endpoint path. Paths are the exact fetched endpoints including pagination.
table_schema.review_body: Body omitted; SHA-256 retained together with review URL, state, author, commit_id and submission time. Raw evidence cache retains body.
table_schema.raw_payload: Only redundant URLs/head SHAs and unused API verbosity are removed; all check outcomes and selection/exclusion evidence are retained.

workflow_context_evidence.purpose: Disambiguate duplicate app/name check contexts and cancelled runs; no workflow dispatch.
